mapper.select: select create_time as paper_time, is_finish, resource_id as paper_id from oj_personal_paper where user_id =#{userId} order by create_time desc

select paper.create_time as paper_time, `count`, is_finish, (select count(*) from oj_paper_practice_theory where paper_id = paper.resource_id and solved = ${TRIED}) as wrong, (select count(*) from oj_paper_practice_theory where paper_id = paper.resource_id and solved = ${SOLVED}) as `right`, (select count(*) from oj_paper_practice_theory where paper_id = paper.resource_id and solved = ${NOT_START}) as not_start from oj_personal_paper as paper where paper.resource_id = #{paperId}
